BiblicalUsage: The word ʼêyd carries the sense of oppression; by implication misfortune, ruin. It appears in Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, Job, and Psalms, and each time it carries that same plain sense. The word keeps that same sense wherever it appears.
TheologicalSignificance: Reading ʼêyd this way, I believe suffering is real, and God does not waste it — He is near to those who suffer. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
